title: Enrollment Manual — One Open Non-Emergency Medical Transportation Benefit per Member
content:
**Clause.** A member holds one Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit, at one RideLink level of service, at a time: at most 1 open benefit per member. A new benefit is opened only when the member has no benefit in pending assessment, active or suspended status.

**Basis of the judgement.** Whether the member already holds an open benefit is read from the company's own benefit records for that member, as they stand before the new benefit is opened. What the member says about an earlier benefit does not replace the record.

**What counts as open.** A benefit is open while its status is pending assessment (opened and awaiting the mobility assessment), active (usable for trips) or suspended (trips suspended after member no-shows). A closed benefit is not open.

| Member's existing benefits on record | Condition for opening a new benefit |
|---|---|
| One in pending assessment status | Not met |
| One in active status | Not met |
| One in suspended status | Not met |
| Only closed benefits | Met |
| None | Met |

**Points of judgement**

- Each new benefit is a separate benefit record with its own effective date; a new benefit is never merged into an earlier one.
- A member whose earlier RideLink benefit closed when a membership ended, and who has no other benefit in the three open statuses, meets the condition.
- A member with a suspended RideLink Ambulatory Sedan benefit does not meet it, however long the suspension has run.
